summary: A computed-style object is live and can reflect later style changes without being an immutable snapshot.

source.pattern: previously returned computed CSSStyleProperties read after style change

target.notes: Preserve CSSOM/parser/renderer semantics; this is not an ordinary C# dictionary or geometry-field access.

semantics.renderer: may recompute resolved values on access

tests.name: normal
tests.input: const e=document.createElement('div'); document.body.append(e); const cs=getComputedStyle(e); e.style.color='rgb(1, 2, 3)'; console.log(cs.color);
tests.expected_behavior: live object can expose the updated resolved color

tests.name: edge
tests.input: const e=document.createElement('div'); document.body.append(e); const cs=getComputedStyle(e); e.remove(); console.log(typeof cs.cssText);
tests.expected_behavior: object identity remains usable while resolved declaration contents are host/style-tree dependent
